headline: It isn't your age doing this on its own —
it's decades of sun, a few specific
medications, and dry skin, stacked together
Cover the skin, review the medication list,
moisturize daily — that's the whole plan
tip: Keep a plain moisturizer by the sink, not in a drawer, so using it daily is the easy default
If bruises are showing up on your torso or with no sun-exposed skin involved at all, that's worth a doctor visit, not a moisturizer
